name: dev.ucp.lodging.customer
title: Customer
description: User-authenticated retrieval of a lodging customer's profile and associated loyalty memberships. The customer is identified by the user identity token, not by a customer identifier in the request. This capability is independent of `dev.ucp.lodging.booking` and of the transactional `dev.ucp.common.loyalty` extension on catalog, cart, and checkout.

include.description: Named response group the Platform is requesting. Well-known values: `profile`, `contacts`, `preferences`, `loyalty`. Unknown values MUST be ignored without error.

read_request.description: Request body for customer retrieval. The authenticated user identity token identifies the customer. An empty object is a well-formed request and asks the Business for its default groups (`profile`, `contacts`, `loyalty`).

include.description: Response groups to return. When present, the Business MUST NOT return groups that were not requested. When omitted, the Business SHOULD return `profile`, `contacts`, and `loyalty`, and MAY omit `preferences` until explicitly requested.

read_response.description: Authenticated customer profile and loyalty memberships.

id.description: Opaque, business-scoped identifier for this customer.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the customer profile. Well-known values: `active`, `inactive`, `suspended`, `closed`.

loyalty.description: Loyalty program memberships for the authenticated customer. Keys are reverse-domain program identifiers (canonical program id on read; same key format as the transactional `loyalty` map on cart and checkout). Values extend `loyalty_membership` with account fields (`balances`, `progress`, `held_benefits`, `partner_memberships`). Platforms MUST treat map keys as opaque program identifiers and MUST NOT infer credentials from nested `display_id` values.
